     康師傅控股有限公司（「本公司」）及其附屬                    Tingyi (Cayman Islands) Holding Corp. (the “Company”), and
     公司（「本集團」）主要在中國從事生產和銷                    its subsidiaries (the “Group”) specialise in the production and
     售 方 便 麵 及 飲 品。 本 集 團 於 1992 年 開 始       distribution of instant noodles and beverages in the People’s
     生 產 方 便 麵， 並 自 1996 年 起 擴 大 業 務 至       Republic of China (the “PRC”). The Group started its instant noodle
     方便食品及飲品；2012 年 3 月，本集團進                 business in 1992, and expanded into the instant food business
     一步拓展飲料業務範圍，完成與 PepsiCo                  and beverage business in 1996. In March 2012, the Group further
     中國飲料業務之戰略聯盟，開始獨家負責                      expanded its beverage business by forming a strategic alliance
     製 造、 灌 裝、 包 裝、 銷 售 及 分 銷 PepsiCo        with PepsiCo for the beverage business in the PRC. The Company
     於中國的非酒精飲料。目前本集團的主要                      exclusively manufactures, bottles, packages, distributes and sells
     產 品， 皆 已 在 中 國 食 品 市 場 佔 有 顯 著 的        PepsiCo non-alcoholic drinks in the PRC. The Group’s main business
     市場地位。據尼爾森 2019 年 12 月數據顯                segments have established leading market shares in the PRC’s food
     示， 以 銷 售 量 為 基 準， 在 2019 年 本 集 團        industry. According to AC Nielsen December 2019 data, based on
     於方便麵及即飲茶（含奶茶）的市場佔有率                     sales volume, in 2019, the Group was the market leader in instant
     分別為 43.3% 及 45.7%，穩居市場領導地               noodles and ready-to-drink teas (incl. milktea), having gained 43.3%
     位；於整體果汁的市場佔有率為 15.9%，                   and 45.7% market shares respectively. In the overall juice drink
     居市場第二位。據 GlobalData 2019 年 12           market, the Group gained 15.9% market share, ranked No.2 in the
     月 數 據 顯 示， 百 事 碳 酸 飲 料 2019 年 銷 售       market. According to GlobalData December 2019 data, based on
     量市佔以 32.9% 居市場第二位。「康師傅」                 sales volume, Pepsi carbonated drinks had 32.9% market share and
     作為中國家喻戶曉的品牌，經過多年的耕                      held a second position. After years of hard work and accumulation,
     耘與積累，深受中國消費者喜愛和支持。                      “Master Kong” has become one of the best known brands among
                                             consumers in the PRC.

     康師傅作為快消品行業的領導品牌，肩負                      Being a leading brand in the fast moving consumer goods industry,
     引領行業食品安全與質量保障的使命，本                      Master Kong has to hold the industry responsibility of food safety
     集團不斷構建和完善管理體系，建立風險                      and quality guarantee. The Group constantly builds and improves
     預防管理機制，實施食品安全的全方位控                      management system, establishes risk prevention management
     制，確保產品質量與安全，為廣大消費者                      system, implements entire control over food safety and ensures
     提供安全、美味、健康的食品。                          product quality and safety. We will constantly strive for product
                                             quality and food safety, as well as provide consumers with safe, tasty
                                             and healthy food.

     絡， 令 新 產 品 更 加 快 速、 有 效 地 登 陸 市         its extensive sales network consisting of 371 sales offices and 182
     場，使得集團產品處於行業領先地位。截                      warehouses serving 36,186 wholesalers and 185,789 direct retailers

06   康師傳控股有限公司
     TINGYI (CAYMAN ISLANDS) HOLDING CORP.
主席報告
Chairman’s Statement

本 集 團 在 過 去 一 年， 延 續「鞏 固、 革 新、    In the past year, the Group has continued its business strategy of
發展」的經營方針，在公司全體同仁的共                “Consolidate, Reform and Develop”. With the joint efforts to all
同努力下，世代交替平穩順暢，企業轉型                colleagues in the company, the Group was able to have a smooth
升級有序推進，為將來的發展奠定了堅實                transition of generation handover and orderly promote the corporate
的基礎。                              transformation and upgrading, laying a solid foundation for future
                                  development.


當前我們正處在一個快速變化的環境中，                We are now in a rapidly changing environment. Social changing
社會的變遷及科技的進步，正逐步影響和                and technology advancing are gradually affecting and shaping the
塑造食品飲料行業的傳統形態，進而演化                traditional form of food and beverage industry, and then evolved a new
出新的生態系統。康師傅亦不斷思考自身                ecosystem. Master Kong also constantly thinking about its own position
在新時代中的定位。「弘揚中華飲食文化」               in the new era. Motivated by the original intention of “Promoting
的初心，促使我們將繼續以消費者的喜愛                Chinese Food & Beverage Culture”, we will continue to take consumer
為 最 高 宗 旨， 以 美 味 創 新 的 產 品， 來 滿   preferences as our ultimate purpose, and to meet public demand for
足大眾對美好生活的需求。「順應行業發                a better life with delicious and innovative products. The “complying-
展趨勢」的革新，確保我們在激烈競爭中                industry-development-trend” innovation ensures that we maintain our
保持優勢，集團積極擁抱新技術，數位化                advantages in fierce competition. The Group actively embraces new
轉型構建敏捷管理，亦加快推進國際化。                technologies, conducts digital transforms and builds agile management,
「善盡企業社會責任」的使命，推動我們在               and also accelerates internationalization. With the mission of “fulfill
環境、社會和公司治理等領域精益求精、                corporate social responsibility”, we strive for excellence in the fields of
追求卓越，盡己之能回饋社會。                    environment, society and corporate governance and contribute to the
                                  society as much as we can.


我們希冀與所有客戶、員工、合作夥伴及                We hope that together with all our customers, employees, partners
股東一起，只爭朝夕，不負韶華，打造具                and shareholders, we will, seize the day and live it to the full, became
有國際影響力的綜合型食品飲料企業，將                a leading food and beverage company with international influence and
康師傅這一「民族品牌」傳遞悠久。                  pass Master Kong as a Chinese ethical brand for years to come.


謹借此機會，對董事會同仁、管理層、各                I would like to take this opportunity to express my sincere gratitude
員工及消費者多年的支持致以衷心感謝。                to all fellow members of the Board, the management, employees and
                                  customers for their support over the years.

合股東期望與審慎資本管理兩者之間保持                    shareholders’ expectations and prudent capital management with
平衡。本公司的股息政策旨在讓股東得以                    a sustainable dividend policy. The Company's dividend policy aims
分享本公司的利潤，同時讓本公司預留足                    to allow shareholders to participate in the Company's profit and for
夠儲備金供日後發展之用。在建議宣佈及                    the Company to retain adequate reserves for future development.
派付股息時，本公司會考慮多項因素：包                    In proposing any dividend payout, the Company would consider

的流動資金水準及未來發展計劃、整體經                    performance, the Group's liquidity levels and future development plans,

      可樂」）擁有控制權及商譽減值之評估                       impairment assessment of goodwill

      （「買賣協議」）和一份授權書令杭州百事可                    execution of sale and purchase agreement (the “SPA”) and a contractual
      樂成為了貴集團的非全資擁有附屬公司。                      arrangement in September 2017. The Group currently holds 50% equity

      及過半投票權。

      合併杭州百事可樂需要重大的判斷和估                       The consolidation of HZPS required a significant amount of judgement
      計， 包 括 釐 定 杭 州 百 事 可 樂 的 擁 有 權。         and estimations, including the determination of control over HZPS. At
      於結算日， 貴集團重新評估是否有任何                      the end of the reporting period, the Group re-assessed whether any

      權 產 生 變 化。 根 據 重 估 結 果， 管 理 層 總         HZPS. Based on the results of the re-assessment, the management
      結   貴集團擁有杭州百事可樂的控制權；                    concluded that the Group has power over HZPS; has exposure to
      須面對可變回報及有能力透過其權力影                       variable returns from its involvement with HZPS; and has the ability to
      響 這 些 回 報。 因 此， 杭 州 百 事 可 樂 繼 續         use its power over HZPS to affect its returns. Therefore, the financial
      在   貴集團截至 2019 年 12 月 31 日止年度           statements of HZPS continue to be consolidated in the Group’s
      的綜合財務報表中合併入賬。                           consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December

           考慮合理且可支持的定量和定                      both quantitative and qualitative information that is
           性信息，包括無需過多的成本                      reasonable and supportable, including historical experience
           或努力即可獲得歷史經驗和前                      and forward-looking information that is available without

     香港財務報告準則第 16 號：租賃                     HKFRS 16: Leases

     香港財務報告準則第 16 號於 2019 年                HKFRS 16 replaces HKAS 17 and related Interpretations for annual
     1 月 1 日或之後開始的年度期間年度                   periods beginning on or after 1 January 2019. It significantly
     取代香港會計準則第 17 號及相關詮                    changes, among others, the lessee accounting by replacing the
     釋。 該 採 納 大 幅 改 變（其 中 包 括 ）承           dual-model under HKAS 17 with a single model which requires a
     租人會計處理並以單一模式取代香                       lessee to recognise right-of-use assets and lease liabilities for the
     港會計準則第 17 號下的雙重模式，                    rights and obligations created by all leases with a term of more
     因而要求承租人就所有租賃產生多                       than 12 months, unless the underlying asset is of low value. For
     於 12 個月的條款之權利及義務確認                    lessor accounting, HKFRS 16 substantially carries forward the
     使 用 權 資 產 及 租 賃 負 債， 除 非 該 等          lessor accounting requirements in HKAS 17. Accordingly, a lessor
     資 產 為 低 價 值 資 產。 出 租 人 會 計 處          continues to classify its leases as operating leases or finance leases,
     理方面，香港財務報告準則第 16 號                    and to account for those two types of leases differently. HKFRS 16
     延續了絕大部份香港財務報告準則                       also requires enhanced disclosures to be provided by lessees and
     第 17 號出租人會計處理的規定。因                    lessors.
     此， 出 租 人 會 繼 續 將 該 租 賃 分 類 為
     營 運 租 賃 或 融 資 租 賃， 並 分 別 認 列
     這 兩 種 類 型 的 租 賃。 香 港 財 務 報 告
     準則第 16 號亦要求加強承租人和出
     租人的披露。
